title: Currency Hint
summary: Shows an approximate, dated conversion of a foreign price and prices a merchant's currency conversion, so budgets abroad use the right number.
description: Shows a foreign price with a clearly approximate, dated conversion ("€49.00 ≈ ₹4,520"), prices a merchant's dynamic currency conversion against the reference rate with a switch back to local currency, estimates card fees and flags stale rates.
catches: Foreign prices read as home-currency prices
Dynamic currency conversion that costs more than the reference rate
Card foreign-transaction fees and tax on them, when you pass the percentages
limits: Rates come from your `rates` prop; the result is an estimate, not what the bank will charge
Card fee and fee tax default to 0% unless you pass them
stops: Budgeted on the wrong currency abroad
